scope: Demo preflight only. No component, registry, lesson, course map, receiver, corpus, manifest, provenance, or generator file is changed.

source_precedence.continuity_note: continuity-preflight.json is useful for the five-section argument and coordinate/timing boundaries. Any retained pre-study CLOSED metrics gate or no-demo recommendation is superseded by the completed receiver study for this preflight; the study's failures must remain visible.
source_precedence.course_state: course.yaml currently has demo: null and no lesson.mdx exists for this lesson. This preflight proposes a bounded spec but does not authorize implementation.

d1.sentence: The learner assembles independent row/column, detuning, twist, duration, and pause gates and watches the same frozen spectral evidence change from a forced key to reject, while a separate temporal lane shows that even an accepted key can miss the 40 ms latency target at 50 ms.
d1.why_not_a_static_figure: A static gate table can show one verdict, but it cannot let the learner disable one gate at a time, expose which naive key leaks through, restore the contract, and compare the resulting decision with the immutable held-out study output.
d1.honesty_boundary: The interaction is a deterministic contract lab over frozen trial cards, not a browser receiver, standards-conformance claim, accuracy retuning surface, or replacement execution of receiver_study.py.

blockers.detail: The demo-builder contract requires course.yaml demo.component and demo.spec, but the repaired lesson entry currently says demo: null.
blockers.resolution: A separate authorized authoring step must set component DtmfDecisionLab and adopt this frozen spec before any component or registry edit.

blockers.detail: No lesson.mdx exists, so D4 cannot yet verify that prose introduces the lab and asks the same task before the embed.
blockers.resolution: The lesson draft must state the three guided tasks below and preserve the gray-zone and empirical-failure disclosures.

not_blockers: No new npm package is needed.
No audio capture, Web Audio API, file upload, network request, worker, timer, or generated corpus is needed.
The existing Panel, PresetGroup, Button, Slider, Readout, and TargetList primitives are sufficient.

proposed_course_spec: Choose one frozen synthetic trial and enable independent pair, detuning, twist, duration/interruption, and pause gates until its declared key-or-reject contract is satisfied. Keep the frozen receiver decision beside the teaching-contract decision; the hard accepted case must still display its measured 50 ms received-onset latency failure, and gray 24-39 ms cases remain unscored.

spectral_evidence.coordinate_guard: Evaluate the eight exact physical nominal frequencies; never label these values ordinary FFT bins.
spectral_evidence.detuning_scan: Around each nominal winner, scan -4% through +4% in 0.25-percentage-point steps.

temporal_qualification.gray_duration_ms: 24 through 39 inclusive; no conformance label and excluded from accuracy
temporal_qualification.latency_origin: first signal-only sample at receiver input to decision boundary

frozen_receiver_contract.threshold_rule: Values are the training-selected local design thresholds. The demo may only enable or disable named gates; it must not expose threshold sliders or optimize against held-out presets.

stored_state: timingCaseIndex: integer 0 through 3, used only by Timing audit
enabledGates: five booleans for pair, detuning, twist, duration/interruption, and pause
derived_only: active preset index, clearing when timing case or gate state differs
teaching-contract decision and first failing gate
conformance label, which is null for gray duration
state_and_interaction.initial_state: Two lows, timingCaseIndex=0, every repair gate disabled. The frozen study false-accepts B although the declared input has two low-group tones and expected label REJECT; this productive failure is visible without interaction.
controls: PresetGroup with exactly four labels: Two lows, Detuned pair, Low twist, Timing audit.
Five Button toggles with aria-pressed; numerical thresholds are visible but immutable.
In Timing audit only, one Slider maps indices 0-3 to Hard 50 ms, Short 22 ms, Gray 26 ms, and Pause 38 ms. Its display and aria-valuetext use those names, not a misleading continuous unit.
Preset selection resets enabled gates to the declared initial disabled state; Reset restores the current preset without changing frozen data.
state_and_interaction.decision_semantics: Show two rows. Frozen study output reproduces receiver-study.json and never changes. Teaching-contract output applies the learner-enabled declarative checks to the frozen trial card; it is an instructional audit, not a claim that held-out receiver accuracy improved.
state_and_interaction.gray_semantics: Receiver output remains key or REJECT, but the conformance row displays UNSCORED/NO LABEL for 24-39 ms and TargetList must never count that case as a correct reject or operation.

presets.label: Two lows
presets.teaching_check: Enabling exactly-one-per-group changes the teaching-contract output from candidate B to REJECT; the immutable study row remains B and discloses one of three negative false accepts.

presets.label: Detuned pair
presets.teaching_check: The nominal winners form a plausible keypad pair, but enabling the fixed 2% detuning gate changes the teaching-contract output to REJECT.

presets.label: Low twist
presets.teaching_check: Enabling the immutable local twist interval [-10,+5] dB changes the teaching-contract output to REJECT.

presets.label: Timing audit
presets.teaching_check: Move across the four exact cases; spectral evidence and temporal qualification remain in separate lanes, and the 50 ms target failure is never repaired or hidden.

cases.label: Hard 50 ms
cases.contract_result: Key 7; accuracy behavior passes, but received-onset latency 50 ms exceeds the prospective 40 ms maximum.

cases.label: Short 22 ms
cases.contract_result: Mandatory non-operation side; duration gate returns REJECT. No qualified 40 ms feature decision exists.

cases.label: Gray 26 ms
cases.contract_result: Receiver may locally return REJECT, but conformance label is null and the case is UNSCORED.

cases.label: Pause 38 ms
cases.contract_result: Enabling the declared >=40 ms pause check changes the teaching-contract output to REJECT; immutable study output 2 preserves another negative false accept.

guided_tasks: Start at Two lows. Observe the frozen false accept B, enable exactly-one-per-group, and make the teaching-contract row REJECT without changing any numerical threshold or the study row.
Use Detuned pair and Low twist. Enable only the matching gate, name the measured value and inclusive local interval that fails, then enable all spectral gates and confirm both remain REJECT.

Use Timing audit. Confirm Hard 50 ms still emits 7 while its <=40 ms latency target fails; Short 22 ms rejects; Gray 26 ms stays unscored; and Pause 38 ms requires the independent pause gate to reach the declared REJECT contract.

visual_and_readouts.layout: Two compact lanes: Spectral evidence on the left/top and Temporal qualification on the right/bottom, converging on Frozen study output and Teaching-contract output. A five-row gate ledger shows enabled, measured value, required rule, and pass/fail.
visual_and_readouts.spectral_lane: Show low/high winner frequencies and amplitudes, runners and dominance, detuning estimates, and measured twist. Use text plus short bars; never infer absent spectral features for cases where the temporal locator returned none.
visual_and_readouts.temporal_lane: Show prior pause, active duration, 40 ms candidate boundary, decision latency, <=23 ms reject region, 24-39 ms unscored gray region, and >=40 ms operate side. The 50 ms latency marker must extend past the 40 ms target marker.
visual_and_readouts.persistent_study_strip: Held-out clean 512/512; held-out 10 dB active-tone-SNR with independent +/-1.5% offsets 1023/1024; negative controls 637/640 rejected; accepted hard-set latency median 45 ms and maximum 50 ms. Label this deterministic synthetic study, not standards conformance.
visual_and_readouts.mobile: At 360 px stack lanes, gate buttons, results, and task list. Bars use percentages within their own cards; no fixed pixel width or horizontal scrolling.
visual_and_readouts.accessibility: All controls are native kit buttons/sliders, keyboard reachable with >=44 px targets. Readout announces decision and first failing gate; TargetList announces task completion. Every color state repeats PASS/FAIL/UNSCORED in text. No motion or audio.

deterministic_checks: The label order has 17 entries: the 16 keys 123A456B789C*0#D plus REJECT.
Selected local thresholds display exactly block energy 0.028, energy 0.035, dominance >=3 dB, twist [-10,+5] dB, and maximum absolute estimated detuning 2%.
Two lows reproduces expected REJECT versus frozen output B; low dominance 3.1659134598699197 dB is just above the 3 dB local threshold, so the miss must not be rewritten as a dominance rejection.
Detuned pair reproduces estimated offsets -3.5% and +4.0% and frozen reason detuning.
Low twist reproduces measured twist -15.55542332926108 dB and frozen reason twist.
Hard 50 ms reproduces key 7, 40 ms duration, 50 ms pause, 10 dB active-tone SNR, channel=true, and 50 ms received-onset latency; the key decision passes while the latency target fails.
Short 22 ms is on the <=23 ms mandatory reject side; Gray 26 ms has no expected label and never enters a task accuracy denominator.
Pause 38 ms reproduces expected REJECT versus frozen output 2 and 42 ms accepted latency; the demo may show a stronger declared pause check but must not claim it reran or improved the frozen study.
Persistent metrics reproduce clean 512/512, hard 1023/1024, negative rejection 637/640, and hard latency maximum 50 ms.
All enabled-gate combinations are finite table lookups and comparisons; no random draw, signal synthesis, correlation loop, async work, or network occurs in the client.
acceptance: D1 sentence appears in the lesson-facing handoff and the initial false accept is understandable in a screenshot.
Exactly four named presets exist; Timing audit has a four-position indexed case slider rather than a fifth preset group.
Frozen study output is immutable and visually distinct from the learner's teaching-contract output.
Spectral evidence and temporal qualification are separate before convergence; N=160 spectral evidence is never described as 40 ms qualification.
No numerical threshold can be tuned, so held-out examples cannot be used for test shopping.
The 50 ms maximum and 637/640 negative result remain visible in every preset and prevent an overall pass or standards-conformance message.
Gray 24-39 ms cases show UNSCORED/NO LABEL and never count as pass, reject correctness, or operation correctness.
The component is one default-exported client file, uses only existing components/ui primitives, contains no external asset/network/audio path, and is at most 200 physical lines.
At implementation time, run a small deterministic data-table check, npx tsc --noEmit, scoped eslint, course validation after lesson creation, and manual light/dark 360 px keyboard review.
